action_instruction: Checking the thread panel reply content
intent: whether the thread panel shows one reply and the nested reply text under the original message

action_params.condition: The thread panel says "1 reply" and shows the reply "Nice, thanks!" nested under the original message.
action_params.query: whether the thread panel shows one reply and the nested reply text under the original message
action_params.code_js: (() => { const text = el(17).innerText; return text.includes('1 reply') && text.includes('Deploy is green') && text.includes('Nice, thanks!'); })()

action_instruction: Reading the Deploy is green reply link
intent: the reply link text for the Deploy is green message in the channel list

action_params.condition: The "Deploy is green" message in the channel list shows a "1 reply" link.
action_params.query: the reply link text for the Deploy is green message in the channel list

assertion_tree.description: the thread panel now says "1 reply" with the reply "Nice, thanks!" shown nested under the original message, and the "Deploy is green" message in the channel list shows a "1 reply" link

sub_results.description: The thread panel says "1 reply" and shows the reply "Nice, thanks!" nested under the original message.
The "Deploy is green" message in the channel list shows a "1 reply" link.

assertion_tree.verification: The current page shows the specified thread-panel reply state and channel-list reply link.
